page.text:
Election Day: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 • Vote Sonia Salwan for Ohlone Community College District Trustee, Area 6
Sonia Salwan for Ohlone Community College District Trustee, Area 6
# Endorsed and supported by teachers, employees & the Alameda Labor Council. Endorsed by the Faculty Association of California Community Colleges
“As Ohlone faculty, we see firsthand how budgetary decisions affect our students and our classrooms. We trust Sonia Salwan to protect taxpayer dollars by ensuring responsible spending, building a stronger college, and putting student learning first.”
United Faculty of Ohlone
#### Sonia Salwan
- Veterinarian, small business owner
- Nonprofit founder
- Alameda County Commissioner on the Status of Women
- Rotary District Vocational Chair
- Former president of a statewide veterinary organization, IAVMA
- Ohlone mom
Sonia Salwan is a longtime Fremont resident.
As a mother of three, Sonia understands the importance of education personally.
As a first-generation immigrant, Sonia understands the challenges that language, communication, and unfamiliar systems can create. She believes community colleges can help students of every background and age build confidence and develop valuable skills.
Sonia believes Ohlone should remain focused on its core mission: helping students succeed while supporting the faculty and staff who make that success possible.
## Leadership Through Service
##### Breaking Barriers
Sonia was the first woman to serve as president of a statewide veterinary organization, IAVMA. She strengthened the organization through fiscal leadership, collaboration, and practical problem solving.
##### Connecting Students With Careers
As Rotary District Vocational Chair, Sonia connects students with professionals, mentors, and career opportunities, helping young people explore pathways for their future.
##### Serving Vulnerable Children
Through her nonprofit work, Sonia has supported programs for foster youth and children affected by human trafficking. She has also supported efforts that provide cleft lip surgeries for children in need.
## Testimonials
“Sonia was instrumental in helping us secure the sutures needed to provide free surgeries for children around the world. She approached the effort with real professionalism and strategic thinking, always looking for ways to maximize the impact of every dollar raised. She's incredibly responsive and reliable — when you work with Sonia, you know you'll get results.”
“Sonia repeatedly demonstrates that she is energetic, service-oriented and results-focused. When confronted by challenges, she's the kind of person that people want on their team, or providing leadership to fulfill its goals.”
## Why Sonia Believes in Ohlone
Two of Sonia’s children attended Ohlone College. She believes a community college can provide students with the space and support they need to find their direction in life.
During the COVID-19 pandemic, many high school students faced distractions. At that time, Sonia enrolled her son in Ohlone College’s dual enrollment program. He went on to complete his degree and, at age 21, began working as a computer engineer at Amazon.
Sonia’s daughter also benefited from the opportunities available through community college. She transferred to UC Davis and was later admitted to a veterinary school.
Sonia believes the opportunities and meaningful guidance contributed to their success. Every student should have access to those opportunities.
Through her work with foster youth, Sonia has seen how many young people aspire to higher education but face significant barriers to completing college. In California, 93% of foster youth say they want to attend college, yet only about 10% attain an associate or bachelor’s degree by age 24. Sonia believes community colleges can help close this gap through mentorship, financial aid guidance, academic support, and consistent support from enrollment through degree completion.
Source: John Burton Advocates for Youth, 2025–2027 Strategic Plan
### Sonia is running for Ohlone Community College District Trustee to support students from all backgrounds.
## Sonia Salwan's Plan for Ohlone
### Students First
Ohlone is facing enrollment challenges. Local students are attending other Bay Area community colleges because the classes they need are unavailable at Ohlone. We must increase access to required and high-demand classes while strengthening academic counseling and mental health resources.
### Fiscal Accountability, Transparency, and Common-Sense Leadership
Ohlone has spent millions of taxpayer dollars on housing planning and consulting, with no construction completed. We need greater fiscal accountability, transparency, and common-sense leadership. We must stop the mismanagement of funds and direct resources toward students and employees. Our spending should support the core mission of a community college: education and student success.
### Expand Access to Ohlone
Open Ohlone’s doors wider by expanding programs that benefit the entire community.
### Fiscal Accountability
Treat taxpayer dollars as carefully as you would your own money. Prioritize investments that directly support students and faculty.
